english.title: Sound a horn / gong / bell / siren fitted to a vehicle in motion on a restricted road at night
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sounded

(A)_[a horn]_
(B)_[a gong]_
(C)_[a bell]_
(D)_[a siren]_

fitted to or carried on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was in motion on a restricted road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at **(..SPECIFY TIME BETWEEN 23.30 HOURS AND 07.00 HOURS..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 99(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 99(5) and 99(6) for exceptions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H191 and H192.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
